text:
Maria S. (sales): Hey team — customer demo in ~2h, they expect a 10min live Q&A with ~8 concurrent users hitting chat. Can we get a short-lived uplift on their hosted key?
Ajay K. (solutions): Which key? Is this the scoped POC key we issued last week or a new ephemeral one?
Maria S. (sales): It's the scoped key from last Friday (scoped to project 'nova-poc'). We can rotate if needed.
Trent I. (infra): Current scoped key has 50 qps soft-limit, 3k tokens/min aggregate. 8 concurrent chatters could spike that depending on prompt sizes. What are the expected tokens per request?
Maria S. (sales): ~250 tokens/request average, maybe bursts to 600 for long completions. Estimate 200 reqs/min at peak.
Trent I. (infra): Ok that's ~50k tokens/min which will exceed current allocation and trigger 429s. We can do a temporary increase for a scheduled window. Need: exact window, requester, and bill code for overage.
Lucy J. (acct exec): Customer is on PO/annual commit but POC budget is limited — any overage will be invoiced. How long do they want the boost?
Maria S. (sales): 2-hour buffer around demo (so 3h total). Requester: maria@redwood.com. Bill code: RDW-SALES-POC.
Ajay K. (solutions): Two options: 1) Temporary quota uplift on the scoped hosted key for the 3h window (fastest). 2) Issue a time-limited ephemeral key with a hard cap and IP allowlist for their demo machines. Ephemeral avoids touching prod keys.
Trent I. (infra): Prefer ephemeral + IP allowlist. I can provision a time-limited key with +3x qps for 3h. Need the IP CIDRs and a tag so we can reverse later.
Maria S. (sales): CIDRs: 34.212.0.0/16 (demo machines) and 18.205.0.0/16 (partner network). Tag: nova-demo-2026.
Ajay K. (solutions): I'll create an ephemeral key and a fallback policy: if we hit 90% of the uplift we'll route to a smaller model (gpt-small-quant) to avoid hard failures.
ops-bot: Support request created: SR-20260321-0891 — temporary key + rate uplift. Window: 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z to 2026-03-21T19:00:00Z. Assigned: Trent I.
Trent I. (infra): Provisioning now. Ephemeral key will be posted to the POC secrets channel and will auto-expire. I will also enable IP allowlist and soft throttles.
Maria S. (sales): Awesome — please share the key + usage guide. Also cc customer SAs so they can test earlier.
Ajay K. (solutions): Docs snippet for the ephemeral key call (for customer):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/keys/issue 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
 -d '{"project":"nova-poc","type":"ephemeral","expires_in":"3h","cidrs":["34.212.0.0/16","18.205.0.0/16"],"quota":{"qps":150,"tokens_per_min":60000}}'
```
Trent I. (infra): Key issued: ephemeral_nova_abc123 (posted to #poc-secrets). Uplift applied. I added a monitoring alert for error-rate >1% and a hard cap fallback to model gpt-small-quant.
Lucy J. (acct exec): I'll note the uplift in the POC invoice. If they exceed the uplift we'll apply overage rate per the POC terms.
Maria S. (sales): Customer confirmed they can test at 15:40Z. Will run a quick smoke test. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
Ajay K. (solutions): If you see 429s, paste the logs here. Prefer we switch to smaller-model fallback rather than dropping requests.
Maria S. (sales): Will do.
Trent I. (infra): Closing loop — uplift will auto-revoke at 19:00Z and the ephemeral key will expire. Leaving monitoring on until 19:30Z.
ops-bot: SR-20260321-0891 status -> RESOLVED (temporary uplift applied, key issued).
